expectations.text: States sbt-ci-release publishes immediately by default and prescribes `CI_SONATYPE_RELEASE=sonaUpload` to keep the Portal validate-then-publish gate
Tells the user to ignore the `sbt-sonatype`/`sonatypeRelease` guidance because it targets the shut-down OSSRH
Diagnoses the missing `_2.13` artifacts as a cross-version staging problem and requires `+publishSigned` to stage every Scala version before a single `sonaUpload`
Sets `crossScalaVersions := Seq("2.13.<x>", "3.3.<x>")` on each published module
Sets `crossScalaVersions := Nil` and `publish / skip := true` on the aggregating root so nothing publishes twice
Recommends compiling the Scala 3 artifacts against the Scala 3 LTS line rather than 3.5, because consumers on an older minor cannot read code compiled with a newer one
States that one deployment holding every cross version publishes together, so no release can ship `_3` without `_2.13`
expectations.evidence: one validated deployment containing every cross version
